resources.string: Mind-Ur-Set asks for one thing before your first check-in: permission to keep what you write on this phone.
Your check-ins, reflections and actions stay in this app\'s storage on this device. Nothing is uploaded.
You can read and delete what you wrote at any time, withdraw this permission from Data and consent, and the crisis numbers work without it.
Without this, a check-in cannot be saved. Everything else still opens.
Save a readable JSON copy of your profile, check-ins, journal entries, reframe sessions, actions, trusted contact, and safety event history to a file you choose.
Could not write the export file. Try another location.
Withdraw consent and delete all local data?

This permanently deletes everything stored on this phone: your profile, check-ins, journal entries, reframe sessions and messages, micro actions, session summaries, memory note, trusted contact, safety events, and consent record. This cannot be undone, and you will return to the consent screen.
Agree to how your data is used before the first check-in.
